purpose: Define the exact fail-closed handoff from personally licensed/local true-OSE raw data into reproducible derived research without assuming the unseen 225Labo schema.

raw_data_policy.reason: Personally licensed raw data must remain local unless explicit rights allow otherwise.

requires: Exact raw filenames and sample rows available locally
Column meanings verified from source documentation or observed sample
Raw parser written only after phase A
No forward fill of unknown missing bars
handoff_phases.output: local normalized minute bars; raw-equivalent data remains local

handoff_phases.target: Nikkei 225 mini long-history confirmation, preferred 2006+ when available

frozen_measurement.rv: sum of squared 5m log returns by frozen trading-day definition

handoff_phases.rule: Stage A FAIL cannot be rescued by a short micro sample.

handoff_phases.target: JNU micro exact-product consistency from 2023+ when available
handoff_phases.rule: Confirm consistency of the frozen Stage-A specification; do not retune horizons or sampling based on micro outcomes.

requires: Prior completed S&P 500 cash-session return with causal alignment

handoff_phases.applies_only_if: An information module passes its prior applicable gates and is proposed to change direction/position.

implementation_guardrail: Do not implement a 225Labo-specific raw parser until an authorized exact local schema/sample is observable. Generic interface/validators may be prepared in advance.
research_outcome_guardrail: No local data processing may modify already-frozen model hypotheses or pass thresholds after outcomes are observed.
